name: SQLite databases
description: SQLite databases as sheets: a page for every table and view, read a screen at a time straight out of the database, so a table of ten million rows opens as fast as one of ten. Shift+F3 gives the report — every table with its columns, keys and indexes, and the statement that made it. Read-only: a database another program holds, a browser's history while the browser runs, is read from a copy.
author: xverb
